monitors.name: LG 29WK600
monitors.notes: Ignores standard VCP 0x60 writes; switches through LG vendor code 0xF4. Generic capabilities list an extra DisplayPort code the panel does not have. Picture-mode values are advertised in decimal and the list is wrong (it includes 9, 10 and 44, which are not modes on this unit, and omits HDR Effect = 39), so only the 10 known modes are offered. Learned on DESKTOP-BPMFO0B: Sharpness, Super Resolution+ and Buzzer change no DDC code; Color Temp (Warm, in Custom) changed no code in one try. Gamma (0xFE) reads 18 in HDR Effect and its advertised list (00 01 02) is wrong. Toggling FreeSync also changes the value read back on 0xF4. Write-verified (address 0x51): brightness, contrast, volume, picture mode, response time, FreeSync. Gamma and black stabilizer ignore DDC writes in Custom and FPS Game 1, so they are read-only.
